messages:
maya: Quick flag 1: noticed NetSuite ledger missing proration stub lines for a batch of invoices created during yesterday's pricing experiment rollout. Customers billed full plan rate instead of pro-rated reduction. ~34 invoices affected.
ben_fin: Yikes. Do we have matching Stripe events showing prorations? Which webhook types are in the wild for those invoices?
maya: Stripe shows `invoice.upcoming` + `invoice.finalized` + `invoice.payment_succeeded`. Our consumer treated `invoice.upcoming` as authoritative and wrote provisional lines to NetSuite immediately. When `invoice.finalized` with proration adjustments arrived later, the handler ignored them because of idempotency logic keyed on invoice.number (we only accept a single write per invoice number).
sam: That sounds like we conflated preview-like events with authoritative ones. `invoice.upcoming` is advisory. We should not create ledger entries from it. How many were written from upcoming vs finalized?
maya: I sampled logs: 34 invoices created from upcoming between 2026-03-21T22:10:00Z and 22:45:00Z. Finalized events arrived 210 minutes later with prorations. NetSuite got the preview lines and no update path existed, so no credit memos were generated.
grace_ops: Finance impact = under-crediting customers (we overcharged). Need list for manual credit memos and a quick fix to prevent future writes from `invoice.upcoming`.
billing-bot: daily-recon job #daily-recon detected 34 mismatches. Job link: /jobs/2345. Total discrepancy: $1,230.12. CSV: /secure-drive/finance/prorate_mismatch_2199991111.csv
ben_fin: Please include customer email, invoice id, delta amount. Finance will approve auto-backfill for totals < $5k. This is below threshold but we still want audit trail.
maya: Plan:
1) Add consumer guard: only persist to NetSuite on `invoice.finalized` or when `status` is `open` and `attempts` > 0? simpler: block `invoice.upcoming` writes entirely.
2) Run backfill to create credit memos for prorations for affected invoices.
3) Add unit/e2e test to assert no writes from upcoming events.
sam: I'll PR the guard now: https://internal/git/stripe-consumer/pull/501. Change summary: skip events with type == "invoice.upcoming" unless a feature-flag is enabled. Also instrument metric `webhook.preview.writes_blocked`.
maya: Preparing dry-run of backfill: command below. Will include audit notes.
```
python scripts/credits_backfill.py --source stripe --ids /secure-drive/finance/prorate_mismatch_2199991111.csv --mode dry-run --out /tmp/backfill_dryrun_2199991111.json
```
sky: (bot) scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC
grace_ops: Please coordinate backfill to avoid interfering with nightly posting window. Run backfill before daily-close at 05:00 UTC.
billing-bot: Backfill dry-run completed: 34 records, total credit amount $1,230.12. Output: /tmp/backfill_dryrun_2199991111.json
ben_fin: Finance approves automated backfill for this run. Ensure we attach explanation to each NetSuite credit memo referencing the Stripe event ids.
maya: Starting backfill with rate limit 10/s, will log NetSuite journal ids as they apply.
sam: Merged guard PR to staging. Canary will be toggled on for staging traffic now.
maya: Backfill finished: job_id=99887. NetSuite credit memos created: 34. Journal refs uploaded to /secure-drive/finance/prorate_journals_2199991111.csv
billing-bot: Re-run reconciliation job #daily-recon after backfill: no remaining mismatches for the affected invoice ids.
ben_fin: Thanks. Filing FIN-489 to capture RCA: cause = consumer wrote provisional `invoice.upcoming` to ledger; fix = guard + backfill + tests. Please include remediation timeline and rollout notes.
grace_ops: Also add monitoring: count of `invoice.upcoming`->write attempts per hour; alert if > 0 in prod after fix.
maya: Will add metric and alert. Closing loop once dashboards show zero.
